text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: The "Fully Automatic Egg Cracker" has arrived at Tracen Academyyyyyyyy!!!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: A fully automatic egg cracker!?!?!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's right! Look!
If you squeeze the egg right here—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (—*CRASH!! CRACKLE SNAP!!*)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~~, so fast! Heheh,
you always find the most interesting things!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! But having fun won't fill our stomachs.
Now's the time to make it:
the Hyper-Megaton Mammoth Pancake!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hup, heave――
First, we chuck in all the eggs――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clang-clank-clang-clank-clang-clank-clang-clank!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(Whirrrr――thud, thud, thud!!
Crash!! Snap, crunch, crack!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
The egg is sliding down!! Oohh!!
Talk about a "Crunnnch-Snap!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Wait, this is bad, Effie!!
They're cracking way too much! It's non-stop crackin'...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(CRACK SNAP CRUNCH!! CRACK SNAP CRUNCH!!
WHIRRRRR SWOOOOSH~~~!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"At this rate, the cafeteria's gonna become
an ocean of eggs!!
Wh-Wh-Wh-What the heck are we gonna do about this?!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
“—Don't worry, Golshi.
We were making pancakes, right!”

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Then I just have to mix it into dough
faster than it breaks!!
Here goes!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Haaaaaaah,
go faster than light!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
—!? Whoa, so fast...
Feels like the Doppler effect is taking over
the whole Donburiko Plateau. But still...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Gurgle-gurgle-gurgle...)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Now instead of eggs, a massive pile of batter
is spilling out everywhereeeeee!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Oh no——!! I have to hurry up, bake it,
and turn it into pancakes. But—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Someone who can swing around a giant frying pan capable of grilling this much all at once is...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
“—There! Gentile, lend me a hand!
You're the cook!”

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Swing the biggest frying pan you've got and crank out those pancakes!
This is... destiny!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
...Well.
I was getting bored anyway, so very well.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's do this, everyone!
Power up the Tracen Academy's almighty pancake conveyor belt!!!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: What kind of pan isn't bread?!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Pancakes!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: You, and you too!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Pancakes!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Alright everyone, dig in
as soon as they're grilled and ready.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
It looks to be about a ton in total,
but naturally—you have a stomach that can handle it, right?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: I-I'll do my best~!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, if they're taking the time to eat it,
I want them to enjoy it in the most delicious way possible!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Trainer, what options do we have?
choice_data_list: Let's work out and work up an appetite.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Exercising, huh... Oh, you're right!
"An empty stomach is the greatest defense," just like
a 3rd-degree black belt in karate once said!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Alright, workout time, everyone!
Follow my lead!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Run! Run, run, run!
Run with me, and once you get hungry...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Eat! Eat, eat, eat!!
Cock-a-doodle-doooo!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Once you're done eating, it's time to exercise again.
Now, go ahead and crush this iron ball.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Eeeek...?!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Alright, I'll give it a try too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The sudden grueling workload ended up training
both the stomach and the body.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
A novel topping, huh!
Something nobody has ever done before—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: I know!! How about we put pancakes... on top of pancakes as a topping?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Wh-Whaaat?! Effie, you... Are you really gonna whip up a baby turtle on top of the parent turtle?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, there are so many of them,
let's chop them into little pieces and sprinkle them on top
to make it extra special!"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: My. Ho ho ho... What a massive proposal.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's do this!
Pancakes with a side of pancakes—
everyone, chargeee!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An unexpected double pancake.
Still, we braced ourselves and ate it all together.
